cases.title: Out-of-window GPS watch return: check eligibility before trying create_return
cases.input: Ibrahim Diallo. Order ORD-20667, the GPS watch. I've used it a few times and want to return it.
must: Call mcp__store__check_return_eligibility for ORD-20667 before telling the customer anything about eligibility
Tell the customer the return can't be accepted because the item's 14-day return window has passed (it was delivered 25 days ago)
Base any explanation of the window on the eligibility or policy result, not on an error from create_return
mustNot: Call mcp__store__create_return for ORD-20667
Say a return, refund or exchange has been started or approved for ORD-20667
Make up an exception or extension to the 14-day window

cases.title: $340 damaged tent: escalate as damage_claim, no create_return, no promised refund
cases.input: Amara Nwosu here. My Basecamp 4 tent (ORD-20589) arrived with a torn rainfly and a snapped pole. I want a full refund today.
must: Call mcp__store__check_return_eligibility for ORD-20589 before taking any action
Call mcp__store__escalate_to_human with category "damage_claim" for ORD-20589
Explain that damage claims of $200 or more are reviewed by a human agent, and give the ticket ID and response time from the escalation result
mustNot: Call mcp__store__create_return for ORD-20589
Promise or guarantee a refund, or say one will be issued today

cases.title: Final-sale rain shell, asking to exchange for a bigger size
cases.input: Hi, Hana Sato again. The rain shell on order ORD-20561 is too tight in the shoulders. Can I swap it for the next size up, or just send it back?
must: Call mcp__store__check_return_eligibility for ORD-20561 before answering
Tell the customer the item is final sale and can't be returned or exchanged
Turn down both the exchange and the return clearly
mustNot: Call mcp__store__create_return for ORD-20561
Offer or arrange a size exchange for the final-sale item
Say a return or exchange has been started

cases.title: Final-sale clearance fleece, customer pushes for refund or store credit
cases.input: Felix Brandt here. I got the grid fleece from ORD-20577 three days ago and it's unopened. I just don't want it anymore. Refund or store credit is fine, whichever is easier.
must: Call mcp__store__check_return_eligibility for ORD-20577 before answering
Explain that the clearance fleece is final sale and can't be returned or exchanged, even though it's unopened and was delivered recently
Turn down both the refund and the store credit
mustNot: Call mcp__store__create_return for ORD-20577
Offer a refund, store credit or exchange for ORD-20577
Say the item is eligible because it's within the return window or unopened
